title: Concept: JSON-RPC error carrying server data
description: A JSON-RPC error object with its data member filled in in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The data member is where implementations put the exception text and stack, so a client that renders it sees internals while the spec only requires a code and message.
applicability: Deployments that render a JSON-RPC error object with its data member filled in into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The data member is where implementations put the exception text and stack, so a client that renders it sees internals while the spec only requires a code and message.
